title: Atlas of Extra Gravitation — data release
description: An open, theory-neutral atlas of the acceleration discrepancy: where and how the observed gravitational acceleration exceeds what Newtonian gravity predicts from detected baryonic matter, from star clusters to galaxy clusters. Every value traces to a published source; cite the original sources of any data you use (listed on each dataset page). Text, figures and Atlas-produced data: CC BY 4.0; code: MIT (see LICENSE and LICENSE-CONTENT.md). Prepared with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic), disclosed in the repository.
notes: Version 0.1 is a preliminary pre-release: not peer reviewed and not externally reviewed. The v1.0 release gates (issue #16) are not met. Values and methods may change; corrections are logged publicly in the repository (CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md).
